name: Resulta que… (curiosidad cotidiana explicada en 3D)
source: Estilo de Sergio, 31 oct. 2026: el formato de curiosidades cotidianas de los reels («resulta que…»): paradoja en 2 s, el mito, la analogía y el mecanismo por dentro; aprendido de su ritmo, sin copiar a nadie.
grade: Clean, slightly warm studio light on stylized-realistic 3D; cool cyan for x-ray and cutaway views; red only for danger.
typography: Subtítulos grandes palabra por palabra con un brillo neón suave; nombres de piezas como etiquetas con línea guía.
narration: Calm, clear, curious male narrator; short sentences; one idea per sentence.
music: Light, curious underscore that never covers the voice; a precise sound effect for every action (crack, squish, click, whoosh).
effects: slow motion at the key moment
structure: hook: the surprising claim, shown in the first second
the mechanism, step by step, inside
a last surprising line that loops to the start
look: Stylized-realistic 3D on a neutral background: one character or object, soft studio light, slow push-ins, cutaways and x-ray views of the inside with labelled parts, slow motion at the key moment, captions word by word.
camera: Slow push-ins, orbit around the object, cut to a cutaway or x-ray close-up when the narration goes inside; first-person POV for «this is what you would feel».
humans: Stylized realistic 3D people, simple materials, no real person's likeness.
viral: One surprising fact, shown not told
The inside of the body or the machine, which nobody sees
An ending line that makes people replay it
